proposal.name: Aggressive Liquidity Mining Renewal
proposal.summary: Boost emissions for rapid TVL growth before a major listing campaign.

vulnerabilities.title: Whale Capture Surface
vulnerabilities.evidence: Token Weighted shows whale-driven passage in 7.8% of runs, with decisive whale votes in 7.5%.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Cap per-wallet influence, add a participant approval floor, or review proposals under a quadratic or hybrid path before execution.

vulnerabilities.title: Toxic Proposal Passage Risk
vulnerabilities.evidence: Token Weighted passes proposals with negative public benefit in 7.8% of runs.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Route treasury-heavy or centralizing proposals through a guarded mechanism or require a second-stage review before execution.

vulnerabilities.title: Mechanism Design Mismatch
vulnerabilities.evidence: Pass rates diverge by 7.8% across mechanisms. Quadratic Voting is materially more resilient than Token Weighted for this proposal profile.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Use the tunnel as a pre-flight check and route risky proposals to the mechanism that minimizes false positives and capture risk.
